recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-12985 unless a future work group decision changes the treatment of _type or the Resource search-parameter generation model.
issue_request: FHIR-12985 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request raised against DSTU2 BaseResource search documentation. It asked why the search.html "Parameters for all resources" list included parameters that were not present on resource.html#search, most notably _type. The accepted resolution was to add _type to the Resource search parameters on resource.html#search.
initial_application: The Jira comment records SVN revision 12796. In the Git mirror this is commit 23782d0d584bb1845900b501156c85c9c451d976, "#12985 - improve type parameter rendering", which added Resource-page search additions and adjusted search parameter rendering support. Later source refactors replaced that injected Resource-page table mechanism with explicit Resource search parameter bundle and search-page summary sources.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini keeps Resource as an active infrastructure resource, and source/hierarchy.xml keeps search.html in the active RESTful API page hierarchy. The current Resource search parameter bundle defines Resource-_type with code _type and type special, and source/search.html now lists _type in both the all-resources narrative and the common-parameters summary table. A later same-change-family issue, FHIR-20640, was already reconciled on the combined branch and restored the _type row in the current search.html summary table, so another source edit for FHIR-12985 would duplicate already-correct current source.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the current build-scope source already satisfies the seed request by defining _type as a Resource-level search parameter and presenting it with the other parameters for all resources.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive issue also concerned _type being missing from current search documentation and is already represented on the combined branch by a source-changing reconciliation commit.
Adjacent 2017 issue clarified _type behavior shortly after FHIR-12985 and appears in the same search-parameter history, but it was not needed to decide this seed.
